items.title: Adobe Releases Critical Security Updates for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source – APSB26-153
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five critical ones. CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap) is a CVSS 10.0 RCE flaw, and CVE-2026-92909 (CVSS 9.8) affects Adobe Commerce B2B, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, gain elevated privileges, or bypass security protections.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to upload dangerous file types, disguised as images, via the REST interface without logging in. CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution through improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, and it affects versions 2.4.4 through 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to the updates in this bulletin.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges, leading to customer account takeover without user interaction. It was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 24, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-73
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 14 vulnerabilities, including critical ones, and was the first to introduce month-stamped releases. It includes the fix for CVE-2026-48356 (PolyShell).
